subject: Trial start summary and next steps — Sunrise Energy
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@sunrise-energy.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@sunrise-energy.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Apr 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Trial start summary and next steps — Sunrise Energy

Hi Alex & Priya,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — really appreciated the context on the latency spikes during peak ingestion windows and the requirement to keep model decisions auditable for internal compliance. Below is a short recap and clear next steps so we can kick off the 4-week trial on Monday 2026-04-12 if that still works for your schedule.

Recap of key pain points you described:
- High variability in inference latency when concurrent jobs hit the streaming ingestion pipeline (seen most between 09:00-12:00 PT).
- Cost unpredictability when batching heuristics are manual and underutilized.
- Need for logs/audit trail for prompt+response pairs tied to request IDs (regulatory team requirement).

Trial objectives & success criteria (agreed):
1) Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end generation latency <= 400ms for the 512-token eval set under expected concurrency (30 concurrent requests).
2) Cost: Reduce estimated cost-per-1k-tokens by at least 20% through batching and caching configurations compared to your existing baseline.
3) Reliability/Observability: All requests show request_id and full prompt/response hashes in the audit log retained for 90 days.
4) Quality: No more than a 3% regression in key evaluation prompts (see prompt set attached).

Scope for the 4-week trial:
- Models: Redwood-hosted open model variants (we'll start with rdl-3b-quant) and fallbacks configured to preserve latency targets.
- Workload: Your anonymized production prompt set (we received a 2000-sample batch during the call).
- Metrics we will track: latency p50/p95, per-route token cost, cache hit rate, and evaluation prompt accuracy.

Owners & roles:
- Sunrise: Alex Mercer (trial sponsor, product owner), Priya Shah (security/compliance).
- Redwood: Karthik Iyer (AE, trial owner), Laura Bennett (Solutions Engineer, setup & evals), Monica Patel (Customer Reliability, monitoring & alerting).

Initial timeline (target):
- 2026-04-06: Exchange access details and firewall IPs (you to share).
- 2026-04-08: Redwood provides trial environment credentials + sample evaluation dashboard.
- 2026-04-12: Trial start (data ingestion begins, live monitoring on).
- 2026-05-10: Trial end, results review and next steps (rollout or pilot expansion).

Access & setup steps we need from Sunrise (action items):
1) Provide list of IP ranges to whitelist for the Redwood ingress endpoints (email to me by 2026-04-06).
2) Create a service account or SSO group for Redwood with read-only access to the anonymized prompt bucket (we only need read).
3) Confirm whether you want prompt/response blobs stored in our managed audit logs or forwarded to your S3 (both options supported).

Attachments included: trial_scope_v1.xlsx (scope matrix), prompt_set_example.json (first 200 evals), redwood_access_instructions.pdf (how to connect + sample tokens).

Next immediate ask: Can you confirm owners and the IP ranges by COB 2026-04-06? If yes, we'll provision the trial environment and send credentials on 2026-04-08.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0121
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@sunrise-energy.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@sunrise-energy.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial start summary and next steps — Sunrise Energy

Karthik — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few quick items:
- Owners confirmed: Alex (me) and Priya for security. I'll loop in infrastructure to send IP ranges today.
- For audit logs: Priya prefers us to ingest logs into our S3 for compliance, but fine with Redwood keeping a duplicate for debugging. We'll provide an S3 bucket ARN and a short-lived role for write access.
- Timeline works — 04/12 start is good.

Two quick questions from our side:
1) Can you confirm whether the 90-day retention for audit logs is configurable to 180 days if we need it later?
2) For the evaluation prompts, can Laura share the exact comparison metric you will use for the <=3% regression callout? Precision vs recall? Weighted top-1 accuracy?

I'll send the IP ranges and the S3 details by EOD.

—Alex
Alex Mercer
Director of Product, Sunrise Energy
alex.mercer@sunrise-energy.com | +1 (617) 555-9876
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@sunrise-energy.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@sunrise-energy.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial start summary and next steps — Sunrise Energy

Alex — great to meet you during the call. Quick answers:
- Retention: We can configure audit log retention per-customer. 90 days is default; we can increase to 180 days for the trial if you want to evaluate longer-term behavior (there is an additional storage charge, which we'll note in the trial cost appendix).
- Eval metric: For the QA-style prompts in your set we'll use weighted top-1 accuracy for the primary signal and also report BLEU and embedding-similarity distributions as secondary signals. The <=3% regression target refers to weighted top-1 accuracy relative to your current production baseline. I'll include a short spec in the shared Drive folder.

I'll attach a short runbook for how we ingest prompt sets and map request IDs to audit log entries (attached: redwood_access_instructions.pdf, prompt_set_example.json). Karthik — Monica and I will handle the onboarding operational steps next week.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@sunrise-energy.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@sunrise-energy.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial start summary and next steps — Sunrise Energy

Looping in operational readiness notes:
- I'll provision the monitoring dashboard and set alerts for p95 latency and cache hit rate. Alert thresholds will be by default 420ms for p95 (notify) and 500ms (sev1) — we can adjust after first 48 hours.
- We'll need the anonymized sample prompt set file in the same format as prompt_set_example.json to run baseline comparisons.
- I'll schedule a 30-minute check-in on Day 3 of the trial to review early metrics (proposed: 2026-04-15 10:00 PT).

Karthik — please confirm you received the IP ranges and S3 details from Alex before I finalize the dashboard.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
